meta.title: RXI Curriculum Construction Model
meta.purpose: Define the curriculum structure, learning pathways, and advanced portfolio-oriented offerings.

curriculum.name: Academic-Augmented Design and Technology Curriculum
curriculum.description: An interdisciplinary curriculum integrating engineering, systems thinking, design, and technology through progressive learning and applied practice.
curriculum.target_learners: Students preparing for advanced academic study and portfolio development.

core_model_a.name: Foundation Core
core_model_a.description: Establish foundational engineering literacy, analytical reasoning, and systems-oriented problem-solving capabilities.

courses.name: Fundamentals of Engineering
courses.role: Introduce engineering principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative analysis, and evidence-based problem-solving.

courses.name: Systems Design and Abstract Modeling
courses.role: Develop systems thinking, abstraction, model construction, and structured design reasoning.

core_model_b.name: Advanced Core
core_model_b.description: Extend foundational capabilities into interdisciplinary design-technology practice and research-oriented communication.

courses.name: Applied Convergence of Design and Technology
courses.role: Integrate design and technology to investigate needs, develop solutions, prototype, and evaluate outcomes.

courses.name: Research and Academic Seminar
courses.role: Develop inquiry, critical reading, evidence-based argumentation, academic discussion, and research communication.

concentrations.description: Specialized learning directions that apply the shared core capabilities within distinct disciplinary and professional contexts.

options.name: UI/UX/HCI
options.focus: Human-computer interaction, user experience, interface design, and human-centered systems.

options.name: Modern Software Development
options.focus: Software engineering, application development, and contemporary development practices.

options.name: Applied AI and Intelligent Systems
options.focus: Applied artificial intelligence, intelligent applications, and AI-enabled systems.

options.name: Robotics
options.focus: Robotic systems, sensing, control, computation, and integrated prototyping.

options.name: Industrial Design and Technologies
options.focus: Product design, materials, fabrication, and design-engineering integration.

options.name: Business Intelligence and Analytics
options.focus: Data analysis, visualization, business intelligence, and evidence-informed decision-making.

pathways.description: Structured combinations of core learning, concentration study, and applied work, tailored to learner goals and intended outcomes.
design_principles: Build on core learning before advanced specialization.
Connect concentrations with applied projects and demonstrable evidence.
Allow combinations to reflect learner interests, readiness, and available resources.

examples.name: Human-Centered Digital Products
examples.outcome: A user-centered digital product supported by design rationale and implementation evidence.

examples.name: AI-Enabled Systems
examples.outcome: An AI-enabled application or prototype with documented requirements, implementation, and evaluation.

examples.name: Intelligent Physical Products
examples.outcome: An integrated physical or robotic prototype supported by design and engineering evidence.

examples.name: Data-Driven Decision Systems
examples.outcome: A data-informed analytical solution or application with interpretable findings.

electives.description: Flexible learning opportunities that extend the core curriculum and concentration pathways according to learner needs.

categories.name: Thematic Electives
categories.description: Focused modules addressing selected topics, methods, or technologies.

categories.name: Project-Based Electives
categories.description: Applied learning organized around a defined problem, project, or demonstrable outcome.

after_module.description: Advanced, outcome-oriented offerings available after relevant core or concentration learning.

offerings.name: Advanced Portfolio Training
offerings.description: Customized advanced training to strengthen portfolio quality, disciplinary depth, and project evidence.

offerings.name: Outcome-Based Course Packages
offerings.description: Integrated learning packages organized around specific academic, research, or portfolio outcomes.

vip_offerings.description: Premium, mentorship-oriented electives designed around progressively more demanding academic and portfolio outcomes.

courses.name: Project Success
courses.outcome: A completed project with clearly documented objectives, process, and deliverables.

courses.name: Research Exploration
courses.outcome: A structured research project with a mini-paper or preprint-style manuscript.

courses.name: Admission Track
courses.outcome: An admission-oriented academic or portfolio package aligned with the learner's target programs.
